review_scope: Frozen captured D05/H15 evaluator, tests, contract and receipt; read-only source review and bounded in-memory tests

independent_execution.method: Project .venv Python -B, 15 pure in-memory unittest methods; two test_cli methods excluded to avoid file writes

confirmed: External trusted source and acceptance pins; CLI byte pins; candidate bytes may vary
Exact immutable source/context, repository ownership and reference-only roles
Bool/numeric distinction and bounded finite-number handling
Unique phases, pilot inclusion, sums, hours/day, calendar ceiling, remaining effort and H15 unknown total
Locale bindings compare with canonical data, not just each other
Explicit bounded input paths; metadata paths and source references never followed
Sanitized typed errors and exclusive output creation
contract_verified_only with semantic review required and false promotion/calibration/installed flags

nonblocking_limitations.detail: Provenance hashing reads evaluator/test/contract source files outside the typed input handler. The verified repository bundle contains them. A future standalone package missing these files could abort instead of returning invalid_input; standalone distribution robustness is unverified.

Presence of three comparison options is not proof of their meanings. Narrative source faithfulness, privacy, usefulness, forecast accuracy and architecture/complexity locale meaning remain outside deterministic verification.
New cases require an explicit profile update. Positive complementary-set quality is not established by these same-role-alternative examples.
